leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the nineteenth season of , Pokémon the Series: XYZ, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the nineteenth season of , Pokémon the Series: XYZ, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Two Pokémon the Series: XYZ Collections were released by in 2016 and 2017, containing the whole season between them.

===Pokémon the Series: XYZ - Collection 1===
 
Pokémon the Series: XYZ - Collection 1 was released by in Australia on December 12, 2016 and in New Zealand on December 1, 2016. It contains three discs with 22 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE7530.

====Contents====
 
 

===Pokémon the Series: XYZ - Collection 2===
 
Pokémon the Series: XYZ - Collection 2 was released by in Australia on February 1, 2017 and in New Zealand on February 15, 2017. It contains three discs with 26 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE7530.

====Contents====
 
 

==Season 19 disc set==
 
The Season 19 DigiPack disc set, also referred to as Pokémon The Series: XYZ Complete Collection in promotional material, was released by in Australia on May 3, 2017 and in New Zealand on May 17, 2017. It contains six discs with 48 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE7629.
 

===Contents===
Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself.
 

==Multi-season releases==
The following are English language Region 4 multi-season releases that include Pokémon the Series: XYZ episodes.
Pokémon Seasons 1-19: Deluxe Edition
Pokémon Seasons 1-20: Ultra Collection
Pokémon Seasons 1-21: Mega Collection

==Trivia==
 
Prior to its release, Pokémon the Series: XYZ - Collection 1 used a different cover featuring . This cover artwork was later used for Pokémon the Series: XYZ - Collection 2.
